name: david-jones-customer-service
description: Guide David Jones customer-service staff through store-specific till and sales-floor procedures.

interface.longDescription: An instruction-only customer-service plugin for David Jones retail workflows. Its first capability is a working till-sale procedure covering rewards lookup, item scanning, detagging, EFTPOS with no cash, receipt printing, bagging, and a courteous close. It does not store credentials, customer data, or connect to a POS.
defaultPrompt: Guide me through the David Jones till sale process.
Walk me through one customer purchase step by step.
What should I do when a till-sale step does not work?
